requirement: Every privileged action must have a documented threat model
Secret fields must never be spoken or remotely mirrored in plaintext
Security prompts must be distinguishable from ordinary application prompts
Loss of network must not remove local recovery
Sensitive accessibility text must be redacted from logs
Privileged approvals must require explicit authorization
Security events must produce structured bounded evidence
Updates must be authenticated and rollback-safe
accessibility_property: accessible update status and rollback reason

requirement: Keys must be separated by purpose and never hardcoded
Security failures must be deterministic and explicit
Remote accessibility channels must be authenticated and encrypted
accessibility_property: semantic remote access without secret leakage

requirement: Third-party GitHub Actions must be pinned to full commit SHA
accessibility_property: CI failures must expose plain-text diagnostics

requirement: Maximum privilege must be temporary scoped and explicitly authorized
Privileged execution identity must be verified before mutation
Privileged operations must emit rollback-aware evidence
GitHub jobs must use least GITHUB_TOKEN permissions and never write-all
accessibility_property: CI denial must provide accessible plain-text reason

requirement: Privileged self-hosted runners must not execute untrusted pull-request code
accessibility_property: accessible operator warning and explicit approval

requirement: Physical desktop must use a dedicated OMNI interactive operator account
Authority beyond the interactive administrator token must be mediated by OMNI Kernel
OMNI must not depend on a LocalSystem interactive desktop
Normal OMNI operation must eliminate the PsExec dependency
accessibility_property: privileged operations remain accessible after migration

requirement: User-to-kernel requests must use bounded operation identifiers rather than arbitrary command strings
Kernel contains only non-bypassable privileged mechanisms
Complex parsers and policy engines must remain outside kernel
Kernel privileged API must use bounded capability identifiers not arbitrary commands
Full screen reader TTS and braille logic should run in user space
Device access must be mediated by kernel or isolated privileged driver boundary
